'''Vekozev Kabir''', nicknamed "'''Zev'''," worked with [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakistan]] resistance groups before he became a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Warfare" /> At the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], he attended [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia's]] pilot briefing before heading to his [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]].<ref name="SWI146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref> Flying under the callsign [[Rogue Eight/Legends|Rogue Eight]] with [[Stax Mullawny]] as his gunner, he was shot down by an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] while defending [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="Warfare" />
[[File:Rogue_Group_TESB_Manga.jpg|250px|thumb|The twelve airspeeders of Rogue Group, including pilot Kabir, attack during the Battle of Hoth.]]

==Personality and traits==
A sympathizer to the Rebellion, Kabir worked with local resistance on his homeworld. Kabir however believed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] could only be beaten if one was to strike at its source of power, leading Kabir to join the Rebellion.

==Behind the scenes==
Vekozev Kabir, originally known only as "Zev Kabir," was identified as one of the pilots seen in Echo Base in the article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]]. The name Vekozev was used to avoid confusion with [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]].<ref name="SWS-FB">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-rogue-pilots-clearance-for-immediate-launch/652924968090947|name=[[Tim Veekhoven|Veekhoven, Tim]]; [[Kevin Beentjes|Beentjes, Kevin]]; [[Sander de Lange|de Lange, Sander]]|date=Dec 4, 2013|quote=The name Vekozev 'Zev' Kabir was used to eliminate confusion with Zev Senesca.|archivedate=20200820181312}}</ref>
